summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms per the spec. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gains Lambda (asserts callable func, stores it, call applies it to img). monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py gains Lambdad (MapTransform subclass that builds one internal Lambda and applies it to each listed key on a shallow dict copy), the Lambda import, Callable added to the typing import, and LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases appended. docs/source/transforms.rst gains Lambda entry before SplitChannel and Lambdad entry after ConcatItemsd. New tests: tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py cover identity, spatial-only slicing, keys view, unlisted-entry preservation, original-mapping immutability, iterable callable applied whole per key, non-callable AssertionError, and empty keys ValueError. Diff check: only the original typing import line is removed (replaced with the Callable version); no added line exceeds 120 characters. Not run: tests, flake8, black, or any repository code, per instructions; verification was by reading the diff. Nothing committed.
